strongest_objection: The declared type and the map's second breath contradict each other, and the ledger shows the contradiction being applied selectively. The of-sentence admits only deals that 'both principals still want, at a price both would still accept', and the boundary claim excludes any death in which 'a party's valuation genuinely changed'; on that test the author cut Rotting subject (runway ends, cargo misses its laycan). But three admitted items fail the same test: in Paid in the tasting the buyer no longer wants the deal because it already has the good; in Parties changed by talking the item concedes outright that the parties who still want the deal 'no longer exist'; in Concession-made option the seller who has learned a rival would bid will not accept the old price. Rotting subject died and these lived only because the author was actually applying a different criterion, endogeneity: the killer must be the deal itself (its outside arrangements, its parties' structures, its talks, its closing) rather than the world or the calendar. That criterion is good and is what makes the second breath a discovery, so the repair is to the type, not to the items. Replacement of-sentence: 'A mechanism by which a deal both principals wanted at a price both would have accepted fails to close without the world, the calendar, or either party's valuation changing from outside, named by the carrier that kills it, an arrangement that existed before the talks, a structure inside one party, the talks themselves, or the act of closing, and by what an outsider misreads the death as.' Under that sentence Market moved and Rotting subject stay out, the three talk-manufactured deaths are in for the stated reason, and the items that do satisfy the strict clause (Price found too precisely, Retrade) keep their 'still clears its reservation' discriminators as a stronger sub-case rather than as the rule. I could not otherwise break the map: the strange members (a trade with no line to post to, a signer whose best move is silence, a number read as character, a deal that dies of its own announcement) survive the boundary and neighbor tests below.

items.item: Parties changed by talking: a long negotiation changes what each party is, so the deal that fit them at the first meeting no longer fits them at the last, as a seller who learns during talks to run the business the buyer's way and no longer needs to sell, or a target's engineers who learn what the acquirer is like and leave; not cold feet, since the parties who began still want the deal they began, and those parties no longer exist.
items.why: Its first illustrative case, a seller who learns during talks to run the business the buyer's way and no longer needs to sell, is Paid in the tasting from the seller's side: the seller consumed the buyer's know-how and the deal became unnecessary. Only the second case (engineers who learn what the acquirer is like and leave) carries the item's own mechanism, in which nothing is transferred and the party is replaced. Replaced the collapsing case and added the discriminator against Paid in the tasting.
items.repair: Parties changed by talking: a long negotiation replaces the party the deal was fitted to, without transferring anything, as a founder who spends a year explaining the company to a buyer and discovers in the telling that she does not want to leave it, or a target's engineers who learn what the acquirer is like and resign before signing; not cold feet, since the parties who began still want the deal they began, and those parties no longer exist, and not Paid in the tasting, since nothing was consumed and the death is measured by who now sits in the chair rather than by what either side can do alone.

items.item: Signer with no upside: a required consent belongs to someone who gains nothing by giving it and is blamed if it goes wrong, as a landlord asked to consent to a lease assignment, a bonding surety asked to approve a change order, or a co-heir; silence is that signer's best move and it runs on no clock, so an outsider reads bureaucratic delay while the deal dies of an asymmetry at one signature the principals cannot buy past without making the signer a party.
items.why: 'It runs on no clock' is stated as a fact of consents, but lease-assignment consent in several jurisdictions carries a deemed-consent or not-unreasonably-withheld rule with a statutory period, and an operator who has assigned a lease knows it. The rule is not a counterexample; it is the cure that names the killer, and saying so makes the mechanism sharper and the modality honest.
items.repair: Signer with no upside: a required consent belongs to someone who gains nothing by giving it and is blamed if it goes wrong, as a landlord asked to consent to a lease assignment, a bonding surety asked to approve a change order, or a co-heir; silence is that signer's best move and it runs on no clock unless a deemed-consent rule has been written onto that one signature, the cure that names the killer, so an outsider reads bureaucratic delay while the deal dies of an asymmetry at one signature the principals cannot buy past without making the signer a party.

items.item: Paid in the tasting: the negotiation delivers enough of the good that the deal is no longer needed, as an acquisition for a team's know-how whose diligence sessions transfer enough of it to build without them, or a partnership whose joint planning teaches each firm what the other knew; distinct from the concession-made option because no third party appears and the buyer's alternative is now its own hands, and an outsider reads a buyer who used the seller.
items.why: Tested as the left neighbor below; survives once Parties changed by talking stops borrowing its mechanism. It fails the strict of-sentence and is the clearest reason the type must be restated to endogeneity.

items.item: Cost of the last mile: closing costs accrue with every week the deal stays open, counsel, held attention, deferred decisions, an expiring rate lock, until the remaining cost to close exceeds the remaining surplus for one side though the surplus never shrank; an outsider reads lost interest, but the deal died on a curve, and by analogy a honeybee swarm that cannot reach quorum on a nest site before its stores run down dies on the same curve.
items.why: The most respectable item on the map (closing cost overtakes surplus), and I was tempted to cut it as a textbook mechanism; kept because 'the surplus never shrank' is a real discriminator and the seriation's one defended hinge, announce-to-force-shut as the carrier of the next death, needs it as the left foot.

neighbor_test.left: Paid in the tasting: the negotiation delivers enough of the good that the deal is no longer needed, as an acquisition for a team's know-how whose diligence sessions transfer enough of it to build without them, or a partnership whose joint planning teaches each firm what the other knew; distinct from the concession-made option because no third party appears and the buyer's alternative is now its own hands, and an outsider reads a buyer who used the seller.
neighbor_test.right: Parties changed by talking: a long negotiation changes what each party is, so the deal that fit them at the first meeting no longer fits them at the last, as a seller who learns during talks to run the business the buyer's way and no longer needs to sell, or a target's engineers who learn what the acquirer is like and leave; not cold feet, since the parties who began still want the deal they began, and those parties no longer exist.
neighbor_test.separating_case: Two firms negotiate an acquisition for a year. Case one: the acquirer's engineers sit in the target's design reviews and leave able to build the product; the good crossed the table before the price did, the buyer's alternative is its own hands, and the remedy is to limit what the buyer sees. Case two: nothing crosses; the target's founder, forced to narrate the company to a buyer for a year, discovers she runs it well and stops wanting to sell, or her engineers meet the acquirer's managers and resign. No know-how moved, no alternative was gained; the chair the deal was fitted to is now occupied by someone else, and the remedy is to shorten the talks or fix who sits in them. Different carriers, different remedies, so the two do not collapse. But the author's own first case for Parties changed (the seller learns to run the business the buyer's way and no longer needs to sell) is case one with the sides swapped, which is why the item needed repair rather than merging.

boundary_case: 'Financing fell through: the buyer's lender withdrew, though both principals still want the deal at the price.' It tempts because both wants are intact and no one at the table changed their mind. Ruling: it is not a member, because it is not a carrier but a morgue label, exactly the kind of outsider's reading the type says each item must be named against. Resolved, it becomes three members or one exclusion: the lender withdrew because a diligence finding was written down (Report that must be acted on), or because its covenant forbids a term the principals agreed (Third chair's clause), or because it gains nothing by consenting and is blamed if it goes wrong (Signer with no upside); or the lender withdrew because credit markets moved, which is exogenous and out. The type holds, and the test shows the 'named by what an outsider misreads it as' clause doing real work: the nonmember is the misreading itself.

seriation.note: The axis has real endpoints: No line to put it on is dead before the first word, Paper as insult has nothing left to kill but the signature, and the four segments (arrangements that predate the talks, structures inside one party, the talks, the closing act) are defended at their boundaries. The Cost of the last mile to Self-moving denominator hinge teaches something real: the operator's standard cure for a stalled last mile, announce it to force it shut, is the carrier of the next death. Within the talks segment the order (record, option, tasting, changed party, legible split, character, cost curve) is not defended in the note and reads as loosely 'what the talks make, from an object to a judgment to a cost'; it is not wrong, and the Tasting/Parties adjacency is now earned by the repair (something transferred beside nothing transferred). The itinerary is declared an interpretation, and the visibility claim (inspectable from inside, seen from the morgue, seen only by someone who has been to the morgue) is marked authored; fine.

edges.from_handle: Report that must be acted on
edges.why: As written the antecedent is 'the buyer prices the written finding', but a documented finding is the most legitimate reason for a price adjustment there is, and it is read as character only when it arrives as a cut to the headline number under exclusivity against a fact the seller had already discounted, so the cut double-counts. The label needs that antecedent or the edge is a bare sequence.
edges.repair_label: If the buyer prices the written finding as a cut to the headline number under exclusivity, then the seller, who always knew it and had already discounted it in the price, reads the cut as double-counting and therefore as an accusation rather than a number, and this branch of the fork ends in character rather than price.

edges.from_handle: Report that must be acted on
edges.why: 'There is no branch on which it is merely priced' is an overclaim stated as fact: the routine closing path for a written finding is neither a headline cut nor a waiver but a ring-fenced instrument, a specific indemnity, an environmental escrow, a bought policy, and deals close on it every week. The fork is real (cut or waive both die) and stays; the overclaim goes, and the surviving branch is named as the passage into impasse-inventions, which sharpens the incompatibility the fork was meant to show.
edges.repair_label: If the buyer instead waives the finding to keep the price, then its own lender's or insurer's covenant, a chair outside the room, refuses the waiver; the record forks into a character death or a third-chair death, and the only branch that closes is the one that neither prices nor waives it but hands it to an instrument of its own, an escrow, a specific indemnity, a bought policy, which is where impasse-inventions begins.

edges.why: The antecedent 'the cure for a missing witness is a record' conflates a third-party attestation with a bilateral paper; Missing witness is by definition a third party's book that cannot be produced, so 'a third party's book' cannot be the escape the label offers. What actually happens is the substitution: the missing audit is replaced by the seller's own representation and warranty, paper from a party, and that is the paper that accuses. Stated that way the incompatibility is tighter than the author claimed: the two deaths together leave exactly one closing instrument, the standard form authored by no one.
edges.repair_label: If the attestation nobody can produce is replaced by one party's own representation and warranty, and the parties' bond reads a party's paper as distrust, then the substitute that cures the missing witness is the carrier of the next death; the third party's book is unavailable by hypothesis and either party's paper accuses, so the only instrument left is a standard form authored by no one.

edges.why: Tested this pair as a second neighbor collapse and it separates: two cofounders six months in without paper. If one asks for a vesting schedule and the other quits offended, the request killed it (Paper as insult). If nobody asks and the first departure finds nothing to point at, so the leaving negotiation reopens every term, the dispute killed it (Ghost closing). Different killers, different cures (a standard form; signing before the first shipment), so the dependency label is a real conditional whose antecedent fails when the paper is demanded by a third party such as a lender or auditor, which carries no accusation; that failure case is the seed below rather than a defect.

'Its only repair is a retrade of its own' is slightly strong (it can also walk, or take a side letter), but the loop claim, that each turn teaches the other side more precision and ends in character, is a genuine relation a sequence hides, and the reverse edge's antecedent (retrade lands at reservation) can fail.

modality_problems: The of-sentence asserts 'both principals still want, at a price both would still accept' as the type while three admitted items (Paid in the tasting, Parties changed by talking, Concession-made option) do not satisfy it; the author's actual criterion is endogeneity of the killer, and the type should say so (replacement text in strongest_objection).

Signer with no upside states 'it runs on no clock' as a fact of consents; deemed-consent rules exist for lease assignment in several jurisdictions. Repaired so the rule appears as the cure that names the killer.
The Report fork's 'no branch on which it is merely priced' is stated as fact against the routine ring-fenced-indemnity closing path. Repaired to a conditional that names the closing branch.

The Franciscan fictive owner, the honeybee quorum, the stock collar, and the union ratification vote are all marked as simplified illustrations or analogies in boundary_claim, and Ghost closing's strong form is marked speculative in the item itself; no illustrative case is asserted as documented history.
duplication: None restated. Adjacencies are declared where they exist: Missing witness against witness-architectures' missing witness (kills the trade, not the fact), No sentence to say it with against impasse-inventions' face-saving fiction (the death when no fiction can be minted). One undeclared adjacency: Signer with no upside sits beside coalition-frictions' veto queue, and adds that the signer is not a coalition member and that the asymmetry, no gain from consenting and blame if it fails, rather than summed latency is what kills. Ratifier's other deal is distinct from impasse-inventions' invented principal (a real ratifier with its own want, not a fiction bought for delay).
best_unresolved_seed: The map plants three cures by re-description without noticing they form a list: the fictive owner that gives a bequest a line to post to, the new name that gives a struck-against term a sentence, and the standard form authored by no one that gives paper no author to accuse. The sharpest member the map points at but does not contain is the request that accuses nobody: a demand for paper that originates with a third party (a lender, an auditor, a registry that records by default, an escrow that signs on performance), which survives both Missing witness and Paper as insult because it is neither a party's paper nor a party's request. The list behind it is 'deaths a rename cures', with its own boundary: which of these seventeen deaths yield to re-description and which require a new party in the room.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after restating the item type to the endogeneity criterion the author had actually applied, repairing one item whose first case collapsed into Paid in the tasting, adding the deemed-consent clock to Signer with no upside, and relabeling three edges to remove the fork's no-priced-branch overclaim and to give the incompatibility a concrete antecedent.
